question: In 2020, India co-sponsored a security council resolution that calls for full, effective and meaningful participation of ______ personnel in peacekeeping operations
solution:
The correct answer is __**Women.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In 2020, India co-sponsored a security council resolution that calls for full, effective and meaningful participation of **women**__ personnel in peacekeeping operations.
 
• Peacekeeping is one of** Indonesia's** priorities during its 2019-2020 term on the Council.
 
• India sent women in the Armed Forces Medical Services to serve in the UN Peacekeeping Mission in the **Republic of Congo in 1960.**
 
• India is the first country to send an all-women Formed Police Unit to** Liberia** in 2007.
 
• India is the** fifth-largest contributor** of uniformed personnel to the UN Peacekeeping Forces
 
• India was elected a **non-permanent member of the UN Security Council **for a two-year term since 2021.
 
• India chaired the powerful 15-nation UN body for the month of **August 2021.**
 
• India will preside over the UN Security Council again for a month in** 2022**
 
• UN Security Council:
 
 
• Headquarters - New York, United States.
 
• Founded On - 24 October 1945.
